name: Engineering Portfolio
headline: Engineering software, built from the geometry up.
summary: PMP-certified Senior Software Developer and CAD/PLM Consultant with 22+ years of experience across CAD customization, geometry algorithms, enterprise PLM architecture, systems integration and AI-driven engineering solutions.
philosophy: Effective engineering solutions need architectural thinking and practical implementation experience. I explore ideas, prototype them, validate technical feasibility and turn promising concepts into useful engineering solutions.

careerTimeline.summary: Supports end-to-end PLM data flows from 3DEXPERIENCE to external systems (SAP ERP, Mentor Capital, ENOVIA), owns CAD/PLM infrastructure across 7 enterprise environments, and built AI prototypes for natural-language CATIA geometry creation and RAG-based PLM search.

CAA features for 3DEXPERIENCE Cloud 2026x; technical standards defined for the developer team
DMU collision analysis: 100% performance improvement through parallelisation
Pre-sales E2E demo environment (EBOM, MBOM, BOP, SOI)

careerTimeline.summary: Led a cross-functional team of about 10, owned the vision, roadmap and delivery of the xCompare CAD model comparison solution, and built a CRC engine on tessellation and PMI data, pixel-based model comparison and a PDM web viewer.
highlights: Led customer projects for Honda, Boeing, Saab, EDAG and Triumph (teams of 5–10)
Honda CATIA V5 → 3DEXPERIENCE migration: batch tools and REST APIs for full data synchronisation
PDM web viewer rendering tessellation data in the browser with Node.js and Three.js
Boeing AI project: neural network for character recognition in CAD annotations
Product owner of in-house products xCompare and Remove Invisible
Built an offshore development centre at Technia India (Pune) with budget and resource responsibility

Geometry checker, mesh generation (CUBIT), 360° automation in CATIA V5
Offshore team coordination (India), Agile/Scrum, specification writing
